title: Whale's Tail Charters
specs: 360° viewing from low-to-the-water zodiac RHIB boats
Learn about resident gray whales and transit the world's smallest navigable harbor
2-6 passengers per boat, no overcrowding for a personalized experience
blurb: Guests board low-to-the-water zodiac RHIB boats for whale watching tours along the Oregon coast. Tours provide 360° viewing and a personalized experience with small groups of 2-6 passengers. Passengers can learn about resident gray whales and transit the world's smallest navigable harbor.
